payload.contentHtml:
cocktail peanut
Hermes Agent 1-Click Launcher

Install, launch and manage the entire hermes agent/gateway stack with 1click.

This 52 sec video goes from install to setup to the first chat with hermes.

Works on all OS. No need for WSL--runs on vanilla windows! cc: @Teknium
@NousResearch

Hermes Agent 一键启动器

一键安装、启动和管理整个 Hermes 代理/网关栈。

这个 52 秒的视频从安装到设置，再到与 Hermes 的第一次聊天。

支持所有操作系统。无需 WSL——可在原生 Windows 上运行！抄送： @Teknium
@NousResearch
@NousResearch

Meet Hermes Agent, the open source agent that grows with you. Hermes Agent remembers what it learns and gets more capable over time, with a multi-level memory system and persistent dedicated machine access.
认识 Hermes Agent，这是一个与你共同成长的开源代理。 Hermes 代理会记住它学到的内容，并随着时间变得更强大，它具备多级存储系统和持续的专用机器访问能力。

热门回复

@cocktail peanut ♥ 30 · 💬 3

Hermes can talk to Pinokio to control any app you have installed, automatically.

Here i ask for video generation. Hermes automatically starts talking to Pinokio, finds the relevant app (WanGP), launches if not already launched, runs it and then returns the generated video.
Hermes 可以与 Pinokio 通信，以自动控制你已安装的任何应用。

在此我请求生成视频。Hermes 会自动开始与 Pinokio 交互，找到相关应用（WanGP），如果尚未启动则启动它，运行该应用后返回生成的视频。

@cocktail peanut ♥ 11 · 💬 1

BTW the gateway works perfectly.

In fact, the agent i've been using to test the agent integration in the Pinokio 7 launch demo was Hermes Agent + Discord integration:


顺便说一句，网关运行完美。

实际上，我一直用来测试 Pinokio 7 发布演示中代理集成的代理是 Hermes Agent + Discord 集成：

@cocktail peanut ♥ 11 · 💬 0

Just realized i totally forgot to mention HOW to get it. Get it on
http://
pinokio.co (you should see it at the top of the "explore" page in pinokio)
刚刚意识到我完全忘了提怎么获取它。获取它在
http://
pinokio.co （你应该能在 Pinokio 的“探索”页面顶部看到它）

@cocktail peanut ♥ 8 · 💬 1

You can open the hermes agent terminal on your phone on the same network, simply by clicking the popout button on the "Launch" tab, and then scanning the QR Code
你可以在同一网络的手机上打开 Hermes 代理终端，只需点击“启动”标签页上的弹出按钮，然后扫描二维码

@JERIC陳傑瑞 ♥ 0 · 💬 0

Love the concept and direction
喜欢这个概念和方向
